plan.adoption_gate: fresh holdout, stable meaningful real-asset gains, no output enlargement or lossless pixel mismatch, <=250 ms extra candidate work observed, bounded <=1 MP, no new production dependency. Do not infer visual acceptance from SSIM.
plan.instrumentation: Removed concurrent stderr candidate diagnostics; v1 retained only for diagnosis.
